news.headline: Moore was limited in each of the first two practices of Week 3 prep due to an ankle injury, but he avoided an injury tag
news.detail: Moore was limited in each of the first two practices of Week 3 prep due to an ankle injury, but he avoided an injury tag for Sunday's game in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, after practicing in full Friday. The veteran wideout has two catches (on five targets) for 59 yards through two regular-season games,

profile: role: WR4 rotational — 8% of targets, 46% of snaps.
availability: not on the league injury report.
